original.description: A line of German infantry lying prone in long grass with Mauser Gewehr 98 rifles, bayonets fixed, wearing field-grey M1910 tunics and Pickelhauben under cloth covers; packs with rolled greatcoats; two men wear the ribbon or cross of the Iron Cross on the breast; a wall and a pylon-like structure on the skyline. Captioned as the First Battle of the Marne, September 1914; Commons notes it was 'possibly staged for the camera' — medals were not normally worn in action.
original.photographer: unknown (German Army photographer, per the source)
original.date: September 1914 (as captioned; possibly a posed photograph of uncertain date)
